summary: Re-verified the PR-presentation-refresh change independently: root cause fixed, all gates green (typecheck/lint/172 unit tests), O1/O2 confirmed non-issues, O3 optional. No code fixes needed; nothing to commit.

decisions.summary: Ship without a regression test asserting the pr-description prompt still instructs the agent to write pr-title.md (review observation O3).
decisions.reasoning: The only way to add it is to export a module-private function (buildInstructions/buildPrompt) purely to assert a prompt string — a public-surface widening that introduces a brittle prompt-content-assertion pattern that exists nowhere in the suite. The runtime degrades gracefully if the instruction is ever dropped (readPrTitle returns null -> title falls back to ctx.task.title), and that fallback path is already tested in create-pr.test.ts. The sole review lens rated O3 low/optional and explicitly non-blocking.
